protocol.beta: source values read by original sampler but all beta_valid false; model masks them to zero
protocol.current_baseline: causally filled candidate, matching D37 evaluator
protocol.future: future states and masks are targets only; forecast_dt query locations are model inputs
protocol.future_baseline: hold each model restored current state, matching D37 evaluator
protocol.future_horizons: 1s/2s nearest valid source timestamp within 0.6*last observed dt
protocol.future_selection: single highest-weight trajectory, no oracle branch selection
protocol.input: same original prepare_batch v3, reset training eval seed per cell/mode, identical batches across checkpoints
protocol.precision: torch.autocast cuda bfloat16, matching D37 evaluate
protocol.read_only: no optimizer, eval+no_grad, all tensor and checkpoint hashes before/after
protocol.reference: prepared source fitted MANO parameters; no mesh/MoCap independence claim
protocol.scope: numeric TWM alone under synthetic corruption; not whole visual system or closed loop
protocol.split: existing recording-disjoint D37 val, not new test
protocol.units: anatomical wrist mm; SO(3) geodesic degrees; finger averages 15 joints

limitations: Windows can overlap; within-cell windows are not independent recordings.
Source and hand motion populations can differ despite recording-balanced sampling.
Only the requested bounded val population is evaluated; no causal attribution from this alone.
Future hold inherits each model current restoration, so gains combine restoration and forecasting.

config.best_selection_description: Current geometry weighted clean/reanchor/noisy/missing/local-strong 20/20/35/20/5, diagnostic strata rather than exact mixture risk; transient cases and legacy stress also reported.

corruption_profile.amplitude_convention: event peak actual norm/angle within severity band; ramp instantaneous amplitude can be below peak lower bound; other groups/frames clean or <=1mm/degree; no additive full errors
corruption_profile.amplitude_sampling: Peak norm/angle uniform within light/medium or rare strong range; direction shared within plateau/ramp/scattered, per-frame independent for jitter

evaluation.paired_corruption_seed: noisy/history_only use matching draws; fixed duration modes can change RNG schedule

corruption_profile.execution_policy: Explicitly selected by a fresh training run; old checkpoints/runs remain preserved
limitations: Mixture, durations, amplitudes and feature scale are engineering hypotheses, not fitted to HaWoR
No future observations or oracle event/quality labels fed to model
References remain fitted MANO; not independent physical ground truth
Window-local error process is not a closed-loop deployment distribution

quality.oracle_quality: optional separately labeled ablation only; not the default condition

corruption_profile.source_sampling: finite full traversal of original four-source train windows; no new images required
corruption_profile.target_policy: All current and future targets remain uncorrupted source reference trajectories

temporal_noise.limitations: events are redrawn across independently sampled overlapping windows, not recording-persistent or learned rollout errors
temporal_noise.process: window-local jitter, fixed-vector plateau, ramp or scattered events; one to four frames; current covers onset/continuation and reanchor covers recovery

corruption_profile.window_cases_description: Reanchor event ends 1..4 frames before current; other nonclean cases include current in error/missing event. All clean case is exact.

definitions.MSE: For each frame/joint, delta=t+r; t=predicted J0-reference J0; r=(predicted J-predicted J0)-(reference J-reference J0). mean_j ||delta||^2=||t||^2+mean_j||r||^2+2*t dot mean_j(r). All three terms in mm^2. Cross term may be negative; ratios are not independent causal contributions.
definitions.axes: Original fixed-camera x/y/z; signed errors predicted minus reference. z is optical depth. Group bias can cancel within or between recordings; inspect MAE/RMSE and per-recording entries.
definitions.constant_bias_control: Oracle subtracts the group signed wrist mean after seeing all its reference frames. RMSE residual=sqrt(E||t||^2-||E(t)||^2). A high bias fraction describes a common offset within that group, not an identifiable correction available to a trajectory-only deployment model.
definitions.control_same_numeric_sourcebeta_predicti: Saved predicted99D with numerical source beta substituted into prediction codec. For left hands source/prediction shapedirs differ, so this is an explicit convention control, NOT a physically matched GT-shape oracle.
definitions.normal_geometry: Every normal branch uses its own saved predicted beta and official HaWoR prediction codec (left shapedirs flip=True); reference is source beta/codec (flip=False). No PA, scale, or rotation fit.
definitions.oracle_GT99D_predbeta_predictioncodec: Post-hoc GT99D state with this input predicted beta in prediction codec, compared with source reference. Shape-related geometric error plus any prediction/reference codec convention mismatch; not pure physical shape error and not a model output.
definitions.oracle_pred99D_sourcebeta_referencecodec: Post-hoc saved predicted99D with source beta in source reference codec. Pose/translation diagnostic under source fitted shape; never fed to prediction. Does not equal an achievable loss improvement, because pose and shape can compensate.
definitions.reduction: Per-frame means over all21 joints; grouped arithmetic mean over valid complete states. Raw additionally requires all17 availability flags. RMSE is sqrt of grouped mean squared error, not mean Euclidean distance. No macro reweighting.
definitions.same_GT_state_beta_codec_control: Decode identical GT99D and numerical source beta in both codecs. Nonzero left differences isolate this decoder convention operation; they do not prove a bug or explain the whole reconstruction error. At zero beta the codecs must agree.

limitations: Read-only post-hoc diagnosis on previously saved predictions; no forward, gradient, retraining, or checkpoint selection.
Beta coefficients from different left-shapedirs conventions are not compared by L2. Geometry mixes pose and shape; oracle error differences are not additive or causal.
Source geometry is fitted MANO, not independently measured MoCap/scanned surface. Same-source FK audit checks implementation consistency only.
Last candidate already includes earlier TWM rounds and self-history. Round deltas are conditional stages, not whole-module causal ablations.
Handedness is confounded with subject, recording, action, and imagery; per-side averages alone cannot establish a mirror bug or a training cause.
GT crop, fixed camera, bounded clips with resets and original HaWoR lookahead remain the evaluation scope; no full official benchmark or long online claim.

formula.crop: b=200*scale=1.2*max(bbox_width,bbox_height); center is original unflipped bbox center; f=mean(fx,fy).
formula.derivative: dTz/ds=-2*f/(b*s^2)=-Tz/s; for relative small ds/s, dTz/Tz≈-ds/s. s→0 produces unbounded depth. Crop-center offsets also multiply the same inverse denominator.
formula.left_mirror: The bridge unflips tx only, then restores pose with SRS. Camera s and depth are not negated by left-image mirroring. The codec left-shapedirs fix changes x components only; predicted beta can still affect all rest-wrist axes.
formula.wrist: raw anatomical J0 = MANO transl + shaped rest J0(predicted beta), in the original fixed camera gauge.

limitations: The original pred_cam tensors were not saved. Raw s is recovered by algebra under the checked bridge/get_trans contract; it is not an independently observed head tensor.
Candidate/final implied s is only an effective reparameterization of their saved states; those branches are not camera-head outputs.
GT implied s uses fitted reference99D/source beta and is an algebraic reference, not an independently measured weak-camera label.

Official get_trans has no denominator clamp and the released linear camera readout has no positive scale activation. This explains a possible amplification mechanism, not why optimization produced a particular scale.
Head-tail sign, left mirroring, and beta conventions must not be blamed solely from a depth outlier. Test whether recovered scales and axes actually support the hypothesis.
1.2 crop dilation follows the current VisualFeedbackRGBDataset._crop implementation; no RGB is read, no model forward/optimizer/checkpoint change occurs.
Threshold counts are descriptive diagnostics, not modified official metrics, filtering, or a decision to remove test frames.
val.worst_frame_selection_note: Post-hoc failure diagnosis only; all original test/val frames remain in all primary metrics.
